name: MIT
body: Pages declare their language and load fast for real visitors. But canonical links point to tlecms.mit.edu, a host that did not answer our request, and the home page names a news story as its canonical.
lesson: Canonical URLs must be public, live, and the page itself. Check them after every CMS or domain change.
summary: www.mit.edu scores 83 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: 19 pages name another URL as canonical.

fix.title: 19 pages name another URL as canonical
fix.evidence: / → https://tlecms.mit.edu/spotlight/crystal-clear-view-ai-monday, /education/ → https://tlecms.mit.edu/education, /research/ → https://tlecms.mit.edu/research, /innovation/ → https://tlecms.mit.edu/innovation and 15 more. Search engines will usually index…
fix.fix: Make each page's canonical point at itself unless it is a real duplicate.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 7 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /, /search/, /feedback/, /search/?redirect-origin=legacy&tab=directory and 3 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: 14 internal links go through a redirect
fix.evidence: /education → /education/, /research → /research/, /innovation → /innovation/, /admissions-aid → /admissions-aid/. Each hop costs crawl budget and a little speed.
fix.fix: Point the links straight at the final address.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 197 ms
